briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch escalates AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with o4 and Gemini 3 releases driving record investment. Regulatory scrutiny intensifies amid rising model capabilities and persistent vulnerabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI debuts o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google ships Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant; xAI and DeepSeek accelerate catch-up releases.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters; TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will safety-first labs maintain lead or will open-weight acceleration force a capabilities-over-safety equilibrium by 2027?
